answer: Random job-bond audit: 500 POA bond per fake identity. Each epoch the registry picks a random 1-in-20 slice by a zephyr gossip round no farm can predict, and demands a fresh signed job receipt from each picked identity. Receipts naming one payer collapse on a mesa into a single vertex, and every clone sharing it is slashed and barred 6 epochs. One job cannot cover two fakes, and parallel jobs still cost one bond each, so a 1,000-fake farm owes 500,000 POA up front. Small honest operators pass easily.
